articles.abstract_en: Many college graduates are underemployed, i.e., work in occupations that do not require a college degree. We document that underemployed workers are less likely to transition to a college occupation the longer they are underemployed and that longer underemployment histories are associated with lower wages in college occupations. To explain these findings, we develop a directed search model with unobserved heterogeneity, occupation-specific human capital, and on the job search. Workers are uncertain about their suitability for college jobs and learn through search. Underemployment is generated by search and information frictions, as workers with a low expected job finding probability in college occupations self-select into underemployment. Once underemployed, workers’ college occupation-specific human capital decays. A quantitative decomposition shows that unobserved heterogeneity explains most of the duration dependence in underemployment.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多大学毕业生处于就业不足状态，即从事不需要大学学位的工作。我们记录到，就业不足的工人转向大学职业的可能性随着就业不足时间的延长而降低，且更长的就业不足历史与大学职业中的较低工资相关。为解释这些发现，我们构建了一个具有未观测异质性、职业特定人力资本和在职搜索的定向搜索模型。工人对其是否适合大学工作存在不确定性，并通过搜索来学习。就业不足由搜索和信息摩擦产生，因为预期在大学职业中找到工作概率较低的工人自我选择进入就业不足状态。一旦就业不足，工人的大学职业特定人力资本会衰减。定量分解显示，未观测异质性解释了就业不足中持续时间依赖的大部分。

articles.title_en: Tokenomics: Optimal monetary and fee policies
articles.title_cn: 代币经济学：最优货币与费用政策
articles.abstract_en: We document properties of crypto monetary policies based on a large sample of tokens. We present a dynamic model to determine the optimal issuance and fee policies for issuers. Committing to low future money growth and fees increases profits, and the degree of commitment matters for equilibrium existence. A Ramsey issuer who maximizes profits, after the initial period, makes choices that maximize the utility value of all tokens. We present a model with probabilistic commitment, solve for the steady state in closed form, and show that empirically relevant long-run money growth rates align with very high levels of commitment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于大量代币样本记录了加密货币货币政策的特点。我们提出了一个动态模型，以确定发行者的最优发行和费用政策。承诺未来低货币增长和低费用能增加利润，且承诺程度对均衡的存在性至关重要。一个在初始期后追求利润最大化的拉姆齐发行者，其选择会使所有代币的效用价值最大化。我们提出了一个具有概率承诺的模型，以闭式解求解稳态，并表明实证相关的长期货币增长率与非常高的承诺水平相一致。

articles.title_en: Skilled immigration frictions as a barrier for young firms
articles.title_cn: 技能移民摩擦作为年轻企业的障碍
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of immigration policy frictions on technology-intensive firms by age cohort. The firm-level empirical evidence shows that H-1B policy restrictions on skilled immigrants directly affect the survival of young firms in technology-intensive sectors. We develop a novel general equilibrium model with firm entry and exit that mimics the policy frictions in the H-1B program. The model matches the age distribution of firms in high-technology sectors and shows that immigration policy reforms that increase the entry of younger firms induce greater exit of older, less productive firms, thereby increasing efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了移民政策摩擦对按年龄分组的技术密集型企业的影响。企业层面的实证证据表明，H-1B政策对技能移民的限制直接影响技术密集型行业中年轻企业的生存。我们开发了一个包含企业进入与退出的新颖一般均衡模型，以模拟H-1B项目中的政策摩擦。该模型匹配了高技术行业企业的年龄分布，并表明增加年轻企业进入的移民政策改革会导致更多效率较低的老年企业退出，从而提高效率。

articles.title_en: Bayesian inference in proxy SVARs with incomplete identification: Re-evaluating the validity of monetary policy instruments
articles.title_cn: 不完全识别下的代理SVAR贝叶斯推断：重新评估货币政策工具的有效性
articles.abstract_en: Instrument validity cannot be tested in a just-identified model, and it is not clear what conclusion to draw when instrument validity is rejected in an over-identified model. In practice, researchers tend to regard instruments as valid when they lead to sensible inferences. This paper develops a proxy structural vector autoregression with imperfect confidence in instrument validity, enabling researchers to incorporate and investigate those prior beliefs alongside other identifying information such as sign restrictions. The empirical application offers a new explanation to the observation in Stock and Watson (2012) that shocks predicted by different monetary policy instruments are correlated with oil and fiscal policy shocks, but not with each other.
articles.abstract_cn: 工具有效性在恰好识别的模型中无法检验，并且在过度识别的模型中，当工具有效性被拒绝时，应得出何种结论尚不明确。在实践中，研究者倾向于在工具导致合理推断时将其视为有效。本文发展了一种对工具有效性具有不完全信心的代理结构向量自回归，使研究者能够将这些先验信念与其他识别信息（如符号约束）一起纳入并加以研究。实证应用为Stock和Watson（2012）的观察提供了新的解释，即不同货币政策工具预测的冲击与石油和财政政策冲击相关，但彼此之间不相关。

articles.abstract_en: Firm-level evidence suggests that turbulence that reshuffles firms’ productivity rankings rises sharply in recessions. An increase in turbulence reallocates labor and capital from high- to low-productivity firms, reducing aggregate TFP and the stock market value of firms. A real business cycle model with heterogeneous firms and financial frictions can generate the observed macroeconomic and reallocation effects of turbulence. In the model, increased turbulence makes high-productivity firms less likely to remain productive, reducing their expected equity values and tightening their borrowing constraints relative to low-productivity firms. This leads to a reallocation that reduces aggregate TFP. Unlike uncertainty, turbulence changes both the conditional mean and the conditional variance of the firm productivity distribution, enabling a turbulence shock to generate a recession with synchronized declines in aggregate activities.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业层面的证据表明，重新洗牌企业生产率排名的动荡在经济衰退期间急剧上升。动荡的增加将劳动力和资本从高生产率企业重新配置到低生产率企业，降低了总体全要素生产率（TFP）和企业的股票市场价值。一个包含异质性企业和金融摩擦的真实商业周期模型能够生成观察到的动荡的宏观经济和重新配置效应。在该模型中，动荡加剧使得高生产率企业保持生产率的可能性降低，从而降低了其预期股权价值，并相对于低生产率企业收紧了其借款约束。这导致了降低总体全要素生产率的重新配置。与不确定性不同，动荡同时改变了企业生产率分布的条件均值和条件方差，使得动荡冲击能够引发经济衰退，并伴随总体活动的同步下降。

articles.title_en: Quantifying the allocative efficiency of capital: The role of capital utilization
articles.title_cn: 量化资本的配置效率：资本利用率的作用
articles.abstract_en: Higher dispersion of log average revenue product of capital (ARPK) is commonly associated with lower capital allocative efficiency. We show this is a result of the assumption that capital utilization is fixed. However, when capital utilization is endogenous, higher capital allocative efficiency is associated with lower dispersion of log average revenue product of capital services (log difference between revenue and utilized capital), not ARPK. Furthermore, contrary to the standard relationship, increases to capital allocative efficiency is associated with higher ARPK dispersion when such improvements arise from greater utilization flexibility. We provide evidence supporting the mechanism and demonstrate counterfactuals where allocative efficiency gains are accompanied by higher ARPK dispersion. Lastly, we apply our framework to study the impact of a capital market liberalization reform in India. We estimate the reform improved allocative efficiency by 0.04%, but counterfactual analysis neglecting the response of utilization would have concluded efficiency gains of 5.25%.
articles.abstract_cn: 对数平均资本收入产品（ARPK）的更高离散度通常与较低的资本配置效率相关联。我们表明，这是假设资本利用率固定的结果。然而，当资本利用率是内生的时，更高的资本配置效率与对数平均资本服务收入产品（收入与已利用资本之间的对数差异）的更低离散度相关，而非ARPK。此外，与标准关系相反，当这种改进源于更大的利用率灵活性时，资本配置效率的提高与更高的ARPK离散度相关。我们提供了支持该机制的证据，并展示了配置效率提升伴随更高ARPK离散度的反事实分析。最后，我们应用我们的框架来研究印度资本市场自由化改革的影响。我们估计该改革将配置效率提高了0.04%，但忽略利用率响应的反事实分析会得出效率提升5.25%的结论。

articles.title_en: Hedge funds and the Treasury cash-futures basis trade
articles.title_cn: 对冲基金与国债现货-期货基差交易
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies hedge funds’ arbitrage positions in the Treasury cash-futures basis trade, which profits from the disconnect between cash and futures prices. At times, the trade has surpassed $1 trillion in gross exposures. Basis traders consistently account for more than 60% of all hedge fund Treasury positions and 70% of all hedge fund repo. We show how frictions can introduce a positive association between arbitrage quantities and spreads, and how these frictions may propagate stress in the Treasury market during periods of instability such as in March 2020.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究对冲基金在国债现货-期货基差交易中的套利头寸，该交易从现货与期货价格之间的脱节中获利。有时，该交易的总风险敞口已超过1万亿美元。基差交易者始终占所有对冲基金国债头寸的60%以上，占所有对冲基金回购的70%以上。我们展示了摩擦如何可能引入套利数量与价差之间的正相关关系，以及这些摩擦如何在如2020年三月等不稳定时期传播国债市场的压力。

articles.title_en: Optimal monetary policy with uncertain private sector foresight
articles.title_cn: 不确定私人部门预见性下的最优货币政策
articles.abstract_en: We model private-sector expectations in a finite-horizon-planning framework: households and firms have limited foresight when making spending, saving, and pricing decisions. In this setting, contrary to standard New Keynesian (NK) models, we show that an “inflation scare” problem can arise in which agents’ longer-run inflation expectations deviate persistently from a central bank’s inflation target. We characterize optimal time-consistent monetary policy when there is uncertainty about the planning horizons of private sector agents and a risk of inflation scares. We show how risk-management considerations modify the optimal “leaning-against-the-wind” principle in the NK literature with a novel, additional preemptive motive to avert inflation scares.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在有限视野规划框架中建模私人部门预期：家庭和企业在做出支出、储蓄和定价决策时具有有限的预见性。在这种设定下，与标准新凯恩斯（NK）模型相反，我们表明可能出现“通胀恐慌”问题，即代理人的长期通胀预期持续偏离中央银行的通胀目标。当私人部门代理人的规划视野存在不确定性且存在通胀恐慌风险时，我们刻画了最优的时间一致性货币政策。我们展示了风险管理考量如何修改NK文献中的最优“逆风而行”原则，并引入一个新的、额外的预防性动机以避免通胀恐慌。
